import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, cost, next;
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int cost, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Edge> edgeList;
    static ArrayList<Integer> nodeHead;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        edgeList.add(new Edge(v, cap, cost, nodeHead.get(u)));
        nodeHead.set(u, edgeList.size() - 1);
        edgeList.add(new Edge(u, 0, -cost, nodeHead.get(v)));
        nodeHead.set(v, edgeList.size() - 1);
    }

    static int readInt(InputStream in) throws IOException {
        int x = 0;
        int c = in.read();
        while (c < '0' || c > '9') {
            if (c == '-') break;
            c = in.read();
        }
        boolean neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = in.read();
        }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = in.read();
        }
        if (neg) x = -x;
        return x;
    }

    static void writeInt(OutputStream out, int x) throws IOException {
        if (x < 0) {
            out.write('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        if (x > 9) writeInt(out, x / 10);
        out.write(x % 10 + '0');
    }

    static void writeln(OutputStream out, int x) throws IOException {
        writeInt(out, x);
        out.write('\n');
    }

    static int sourceNode, sinkNode;
    static ArrayList<Integer> distance, minFlow, parentVertex, parentEdge;
    static ArrayList<Boolean> inQueue;

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(distance.toArray(), INF);
        Arrays.fill(minFlow.toArray(), 0);
        Arrays.fill(parentVertex.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(parentEdge.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue.toArray(), false);
        
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distance.set(sourceNode, 0);
        minFlow.set(sourceNode, INF);
        q.add(sourceNode);
        inQueue.set(sourceNode, true);
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQueue.set(u, false);
            
            for (int i = nodeHead.get(u); i != -1; i = edgeList.get(i).next) {
                int v = edgeList.get(i).to;
                int cap = edgeList.get(i).capacity;
                int cost = edgeList.get(i).cost;
                
                if (cap > 0 && distance.get(v) > distance.get(u) + cost) {
                    distance.set(v, distance.get(u) + cost);
                    minFlow.set(v, Math.min(minFlow.get(u), cap));
                    parentVertex.set(v, u);
                    parentEdge.set(v, i);
                    if (!inQueue.get(v)) {
                        q.add(v);
                        inQueue.set(v, true);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return parentVertex.get(sinkNode) != -1;
    }

    static int totalFlow, minCost;

    static void minCostMaxFlow() {
        while (spfa()) {
            int flowAmount = minFlow.get(sinkNode);
            totalFlow += flowAmount;
            minCost += flowAmount * distance.get(sinkNode);
            
            int current = sinkNode;
            while (current != sourceNode) {
                int edgeIndex = parentEdge.get(current);
                Edge forwardEdge = edgeList.get(edgeIndex);
                Edge backwardEdge = edgeList.get(edgeIndex ^ 1);
                
                forwardEdge.capacity -= flowAmount;
                backwardEdge.capacity += flowAmount;
                
                current = parentVertex.get(current);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(line[2]);
        int c = Integer.parseInt(line[3]);
        int d = Integer.parseInt(line[4]);
        
        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        sourceNode = n * (2 * B + 1) + 1;
        sinkNode = sourceNode + 1;
        
        distance = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, INF));
        minFlow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, 0));
        parentVertex = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, -1));
        parentEdge = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, -1));
        inQueue = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, false));
        nodeHead = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sinkNode + 1, -1));
        edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            addEdge(sourceNode, x, 1, 0);
        }
        
        addEdge(n * (2 * B) + 1, sinkNode, INF, 0);
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
            addEdge(layer * n + 1, (layer + 1) * n + 1, INF, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                addEdge(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, INF, c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            String[] edgeLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
            int x = Integer.parseInt(edgeLine[0]);
            int y = Integer.parseInt(edgeLine[1]);
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * j - 1) + c;
                    addEdge(layer * n + x, (layer + 1) * n + y, 1, cost);
                    addEdge(layer * n + y, (layer + 1) * n + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }
        
        minCostMaxFlow();
        System.out.println(minCost);
    }
}
